body:
Add the Features tab to the Strategy page. It lists features grouped by target milestone.

- Add the `Feature(id, title, body, milestone: Option(String), rank: Float, state: String)` type and a decoder where every field except `id` is optional. Give milestones a `rank`. Keep `features: List(Feature)` in the model. Adapt `keep`/`records`, the link selects and the test helpers.
- `src/features.gleam` (D-90: one component per tab) shows milestone groups in rank order, then "No milestone". Inside each group, features are sorted by rank, then id. Each feature shows its title, a state badge, its body as Markdown (`solace_task.md`) and its linked tasks (`row.feature == Some(id)` across all projects). Clicking a task sends `Open(dir, id)` and switches to the Tasks tab.
- Tests: the decoder and its defaults, grouping and order, and an `api.test.mjs` step that renders the list. Add a "Features tab" section to the README.
title: Strategy Features tab: read-only list
